prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A stylized ceremonial lyre — a small curved harp-frame with three or
four taut vertical strings across the opening. Flat app-icon geometry,
saturated palette colors, centered.
formatted_prompt: Flat app-icon illustration, bold vector geometry centered on a plain off-white canvas with generous padding. A ceremonial lyre rendered as a single crisp silhouette: a vivid red (#FF0000) curved U-shaped frame with a clean crossbar at the top, three bold vertical strings in pure yellow (#FFFF00) spanning the opening as flat rectangular strips. The base of the frame anchors the composition with a slightly thicker flat shape for visual weight. No gradients, no textures, no brushwork — every edge sharp and deliberate. High contrast between the red frame and yellow strings against the white ground. Flat bold fills, comic-book color confidence, fully readable at 16px.
